title: SM PSS2C
text: 离散时间或连续时间单输入 PSS2C 电力系统稳定器，输入 2 路、输出 1 路；按 {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间；{PSS gain, K_S1 (pu)} 指定电力系统稳定器前向通路增益、{PSS gain, K_S2 (pu)} 指定电力系统稳定器传感器增益、{PSS gain, K_S3 (pu)} 指定电力系统稳定器增益、{PSS transducer time constant, T_6 (s)} 指定传感器时间常数、{PSS transducer time constant, T_7 (s)} 指定传感器时间常数、{PSS washout time constant, T_w1 (s)} 指定 Washout 时间常数、{PSS washout time constant, T_w2 (s)} 指定 Washout 时间常数、{PSS washout time constant, T_w3 (s)} 指定 Washout 时间常数、{PSS washout time constant, T_w4 (s)} 指定 Washout 时间常数、{PSS transducer time constant, T_8 (s)} 指定传感器时间常数、{PSS washout time constant, T_9 (s)} 指定 Washout 时间常数、{Denominator exponent for ramp-track filter, M} 指定斜坡跟踪滤波器分母的指数、{Overall exponent for ramp-track filter, N} 指定斜坡跟踪滤波器的总指数、{PSS numerator (lead) compensating time constant (first block), T_1 (s)} 指定超前时间常数、{PSS denominator (lag) compensating time constant (first block), T_2 (s)} 指定滞后时间常数、{PSS numerator (lead) compensating time constant (second block), T_3 (s)} 指定超前时间常数、{PSS denominator (lag) compensating time constant (second block), T_4 (s)} 指定滞后时间常数、{PSS denominator (lead) compensating time constant (third block), T_10 (s)} 指定滞后时间常数、{PSS denominator (lag) compensating time constant (third block), T_11 (s)} 指定滞后时间常数、{PSS denominator (lead) compensating time constant (fourth block), T_12 (s)} 指定滞后时间常数、{PSS denominator (lag) compensating time constant (fourth block), T_13 (s)} 指定滞后时间常数、{Maximum PSS output, V_STmax (pu)} 指定最大稳定、{Minimum PSS output, V_STmin (pu)} 指定最小稳定、{Input signal #1 maximum limit, V_S1max (pu)} 指定第一个输入的最大限值、{Input signal #1 minimum limit, V_S1min (pu)} 指定第一个输入的最小限值、{Input signal #2 maximum limit, V_S2max (pu)} 指定第二个输入的最大限值、{Input signal #2 minimum limit, V_S2min (pu)} 指定第二个输入的最小限值、{Generator MW threshold for PSS activation, P_PSSon (pu)} 指定电力系统稳定器激活的发电机阈值、{Generator MW threshold for PSS de-activation, P_PSSoff (pu)} 指定电力系统稳定器停用的发电机阈值，按实例取值。

params.values: 斜坡跟踪滤波器的总指数 1 (default) | scalar
